Definition: flash (of the eyes); in a bad sense, blearedness
BiblicalUsage: Chakliluwth is redness of the eyes, blearedness — one of the woes of the drunkard, asked in a string of sorrows: who has woe, who has sorrow, who has contentions, who has wounds without cause, who has redness of eyes?
TheologicalSignificance: I believe red eyes are the wine's signature, and the proverb reads them aloud so no one has to guess.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
